# posts.remove — DELETE /posts/{id}

Delete a post

Deletes the post and all its comments. Only the author may delete, otherwise 403.

## Call
```ts
const res = await user.posts.remove({ path: { id: "0" } })
res.assert(204)
```

## Input
```ts
{ path: {
  /** Post id. */
  "id": string
} }
```

## Responses
```ts
204: unknown // Deleted. Empty body.
401: ErrorDto // Missing or invalid bearer token.
403: ErrorDto // The current user is not the author.
404: ErrorDto // No post with this id.
```

## Types
```ts
type ErrorDto = {
  /** HTTP status code. */
  "statusCode": number
  /** Error message. Validation errors (400) return a list: one message per failed constraint. */
  "message": string | Array<string>
  /** HTTP status text, e.g. "Not Found". */
  "error"?: string
}
```
